items.t: Gulf Coast Diva Angels hosting Halloween Poker Run for Manatee County Special Olympics athletes
items.x: The Gulf Coast Diva Angels are hosting a Halloween Poker Run Oct. 31 to benefit Special Olympics Florida in Manatee County. Motorcycles and cars are welcome, with costume contests, prizes and a closing party planned.

items.t: Manatee County approves more than $100 million for stormwater, hurricane recovery projects
